name: Contrada Bricconi
dinnerNote: Tasting menu, 10 courses (6 courses for under-30s €95)
dinnerNoteIt: Menu degustazione, 10 portate (6 portate per gli under 30 €95)

menus.name: tasting menu
menus.note: The only menu, lunch or dinner, Friday to Monday; drinks extra; extra dishes can be added

menus.name: under-30s menu
menus.note: Only for guests under 30; a shorter version of the tasting menu; drinks extra

bookingOpens: Online with the booking request form on the restaurant's website (Prenota-web), or by phone or email (ristorante@contradabricconi.it). Open Friday to Monday for lunch and dinner. A credit card is needed to hold every booking, even with a gift voucher, and the booking is only confirmed once the restaurant's official confirmation email arrives.
cancellation: Free up to 48 hours before the booking. Later cancellations, no-shows and changes not passed on in time are charged the penalty stated in the booking confirmation.
dressCode: No dress code, but clothes suited to a mountain farm are advised, and comfortable shoes: the hamlet's paving is not suited to heels.
children: Children are welcome; those up to 11 get a simpler menu. The dining room is small, with tables close together. Dogs and other pets are welcome if mentioned in the booking notes.
